concept_gloss.applicability: Topluluğun her kesimden bütün üyelerle, çok sayıda ve kimse geride kalmadan geldiği tam durumu anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk bütünlüğünü, kimsenin eksik olmamasını, farklı konumdaki üyeleri ve sayısal çokluğu korur.

concept_gloss.text: bütün topluluğun kalabalık ve eksiksiz gelişi

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun bütün üyeleriyle, yüksek ve düşük konumdakiler birlikte, kalabalık biçimde ve hiç kimse geride kalmadan gelmesini belirten söz öbekleridir.

facets.statement: Topluluğun bütün üyeleri birlikte gelir ve hiç kimse geride kalmaz.
Gelenlerin içinde yüksek ve düşük konumdaki kişiler ayrım yapılmadan bulunur.
Topluluğun gelişi aynı zamanda sayıca çok ve kalabalıktır.
Aynı bütünlük ve çokluk anlamı üç yakın söz öbeği biçiminde tanıklanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun bütün üyeleriyle geldiğini doğal akan bir cümlede belirtmek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Birlikte gelişi, sayısal çokluğu ve hiçbir üyenin geride kalmamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: hep birlikte, kalabalık ve eksiksiz olarak

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun kalabalıklığından çok kimsenin geride kalmaması özellikle vurgulandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Topluluğun sayıca çok olması ve farklı toplumsal konumlardaki kişileri birlikte içermesi açıkça belirtilmez.
error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun eksiksiz oluşunu ve her üyenin katılmasını açık biçimde korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca verilen grup ifadelerine bağlıdır; genel çokluk, sıradan topluluk veya bağımsız bir örtme anlamı olarak kullanılamaz.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli söz öbeklerini bir topluluğun yüksek ve düşük konumdaki bütün üyeleriyle, kalabalık ve hiç kimse geride kalmadan gelmesi anlamında açıklar. Dal imgesi bu bütünlük, çeşitlilik ve çokluk koşullarını doğru biçimde korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bütün topluluk, kalabalık ve kimse eksik olmadan

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnızca tanıklanan grup ifadelerine bağlıdır; bütün topluluğun kalabalık ve eksiksiz gelişi anlamı bağımsız bir kök anlamına genellenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel topluluk, büyük kalabalık, salt insan çokluğu ve parça-bütün karşıtlığıyla dört yararlı sınır seçildi, önderlik ya da bağlılık odaklı adaylar elendi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı eksiksiz katılım ve birlikte geliş koşulu taşıyan belirli ifadelerdir; komşu dal topluluğu bağımsız bir ad olarak daha geniş kullanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli ifadelerde topluluğun tüm kesimleriyle, hiç kimse eksik kalmadan ve kalabalık biçimde gelmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel insan topluluğunu, üst üste yığılmış kalabalığı, kabileleri birleştiren kümeleri ve önderleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bütün bir insan topluluğunu ve kalabalık grubu anlatma alanında kesişir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında kalabalıklığa eksiksizlik ve bütün kesimlerin katılımı eklenir; komşu dal için sayısal çokluk yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yüksek ve düşük konumdaki herkesin bulunmasını ve tek kişinin bile geride kalmamasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çok sayıda insanı ya da kalabalığın bir defalık gelişini, bütün üyelerin katılımı koşulu olmadan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sayıca çok insanın bir arada bulunmasını veya gelmesini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının çekirdeği topluluğun eksiksiz katılımıdır; komşu dal salt insan sayısının çokluğunu verir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli yapılarda bütün topluluğun birlikte ve kimse eksik olmadan gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnızca çok sayıda insanı belirtir; birlikte geliş ve tam katılım koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kalabalık bir insan grubunu anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kapsamın tamamını ve eksiksizliği, komşu dal ise bütünden daha dar bir parça veya kesimi belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Topluluğu bütün üyeleriyle ve hiçbir parçası eksik olmadan ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir bütünün yalnızca bir parçasını veya içinden ayrılmış bir kesimi ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir topluluğun ya da bütünün kapsamını, tamlık ile parça olma ekseninde belirler.

text.arabic_uthmani: فَمَن تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ظُلْمِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

baseline.text: Kim haksızlığından sonra tövbe eder ve kendini düzeltirse Allah onun tövbesini kabul eder. Şüphesiz Allah çok bağışlayıcıdır, merhametlidir.

activation_trace.role: Eliciting repentance supplies a responsive interpersonal image, making the two focus verbs a return-and-reception circuit.

changed_reading.after: Repentance is a two-sided re-entry: accountable human return is answered by divine turning toward the repaired person.
changed_reading.before: An offender repents and is then forgiven.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired تَابَ and يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِ repeat ت و ب at focus words 2 and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root distributes movement across two agents: the wrongdoer turns after wrongdoing and repairs, then God turns toward that person. The branch image of eliciting repentance makes the sequence relational rather than a one-sided change of mood.

activation_trace.role: Misplacing something in an improper place or time renders the wrongdoing as created disorder.
Repair as the opposite of corruption supplies the corrective action.
Fitness and suitability sharpen repair as returning affairs to an appropriate configuration.

changed_reading.after: Repentance requires locating what the wrong displaced and making that damaged order fit again.
changed_reading.before: Repentance means ceasing the offense and becoming generally better.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact sequence مِنۢ بَعْدِ ظُلْمِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ joins wrongdoing directly to repair.
baseline_models.mechanism: ظلم can image putting something in the wrong place or time, while أصلح opposes corruption and restores fitness. Reform therefore diagnoses and corrects the disorder produced by the wrong, rather than merely adding later good conduct.

activation_trace.role: A grievance seeking redress keeps the injured party and outstanding claim inside the meaning of the wrong.
Withholding a right specifies what repair may have to release or restore.
Removing estrangement supplies the social completion of redress.

changed_reading.after: The divine-facing return is inseparable from repairing withheld rights and the human relationship injured by the wrong.
changed_reading.before: Repentance is private remorse between the offender and God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظُلْمِهِۦ and أَصْلَحَ can both open onto relations damaged by the offender.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wrong can leave a grievance and a withheld right; repair can remove estrangement between people. The focus thus carries a claimant-facing path from acknowledged liability to redress and reconciliation.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover gives forgiveness a protective rather than merely subtractive function.
Covering the offense while shielding its bearer from its effect locates mercy after acknowledged liability.
Tenderness and benefaction make the protection restorative rather than merely defensive.

changed_reading.after: After return and repair, forgiveness shelters the person from being permanently reduced to the wrong and mercy supports restored life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The close إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ follows the return-and-repair condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: غفر supplies covering that preserves and shields from an offense's effect, while رحم supplies tender benefaction. The result is protected restoration after accountability, not denial that the damage occurred.

activation_trace.role: The responsive return exceeds an affective reaction by opening a changed relation.
Repair against corruption supplies the action absent from bare regret.
Regret over what has passed marks an emotional aftermath that does not itself restore the slain life.
Departure from sound order names the destructive field that repair must reverse.
Preserving life supplies a concrete positive direction for إصلاح after destructive wrongdoing.
A second regret produced by exposed calculations confirms that regret can arise from loss without yet constituting repair.

changed_reading.after: Sorrow remains ambiguous until it crosses into accountable, life-preserving repair of the damage.
changed_reading.before: Sincere sorrow is the core evidence of repentance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context twice reaches becoming regretful, once after the brother's death and once after concealed commitments are exposed, without naming that state توبة or إصلاح. Between those scenes, corruption is opposed by preserving life. This makes the focus's added repair the observable conversion of regret into life-preserving benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two regret scenes and a corruption/life-preservation opposition; I infer that their omission of explicit repair is contrastive and that life-giving benefit exemplifies repair. A live alternative is that regret is an initial stage which could later become repentance.
structural_cues: 5:31 and 5:52 both end in becoming regretful, but 5:39 uniquely couples return with repair.
5:32 places preservation of life against corruption before the focus's أصلح.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering anchors the comparison while preserving forgiveness's positive function.
Repair prevents the divine cover from being reduced to concealment without change.
Putting the exposed body behind sight supplies a materially different kind of covering for contrast.
Purifying self and action from ugliness supplies the inner change that separates redemptive covering from invisibility.

changed_reading.after: God's cover protects after acknowledged damage is repaired and the agent changes; it is not permission to leave the wrong merely out of sight.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness means that God hides the offense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brother's body is covered from sight, while later hearts are described as not purified; against both, the focus's غفر-cover comes only after return and repair. Divine covering is therefore distinguishable from merely making damage invisible: it protects a person through a morally cleansing transition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily concealment, absent heart-purification, and the focus's repair-conditioned cover; I infer a contrast among these coverings. Burial may instead be an act of dignity rather than evasion, so the contrast is diagnostic but not exclusive.
structural_cues: The first pericope moves from killing to covering the body's exposure and regret.
The later judgment scene distinguishes verbal profession from hearts not purified.

activation_trace.role: Temporal succession anchors the focus promise after wrongdoing rather than before apprehension.
Responsive repentance supplies the shared relational mechanism across the paired formulations.
The earlier repentance occurrence establishes the near-repeated frame.
Precedence marks a deadline relative to the community's action.
Gaining effective power identifies the human enforcement horizon to which 'before' attaches.
The repeated divine shielding close links the two temporal formulations without collapsing their legal settings.

changed_reading.after: The focus promises divine turning after wrongdoing and repair while leaving the separately marked horizon of human enforcement unresolved.
changed_reading.before: Repentance either automatically cancels punishment or becomes unavailable once punishment is possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: 5:34 and 5:39 nearly repeat repentance followed by divine forgiveness and mercy, but they mark different clocks: before others gain power over offenders, versus after one's wrongdoing with repair. The repetition separates the timing of human apprehension from the availability of divine responsive return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame and opposed temporal relations; I infer that human enforcement timing and divine acceptance are distinct questions. The verses concern different offense formulations, so they do not by themselves yield a universal rule about penalties.
structural_cues: 5:34 and 5:39 share توبة and the غفور رحيم close.
5:34 says before you gain power over them; 5:39 says after his wrongdoing and adds repair.

activation_trace.role: Responsive personal return anchors the non-substitutable change of agent.
Actual correction supplies what a detached payment cannot perform by itself.
Offering one thing as a substitute for another supplies the blocked transactional model.
Refused acceptance shows that maximal external value does not purchase the needed relation.

changed_reading.after: Restitution may repair a right, but no transferred value substitutes for the wrongdoer's own return and corrective action.
changed_reading.before: A sufficiently large payment or sacrifice can stand in for reform.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rejected attempt to substitute all earthly wealth for the self contrasts with the focus's accepted route of return plus repair. Compensation can belong to repair, but an external asset cannot replace the offender's changed agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected substitution and a person-centered repair sequence; I infer a contrast between buying release and becoming reparative. The ransom scene is eschatological, so it does not disqualify material restitution within earthly repair.
structural_cues: The failed ransom immediately precedes the theft ruling and the focus's return-and-repair route.
5:36 uses non-acceptance, whereas 5:39 uses God's answering turn toward the person.

activation_trace.role: Removal of estrangement supplies the reintegrative vector after sanction's separation.
The answering turn toward the repaired person prevents sanction from being the sequence's final relation.
Severance supplies the immediate punitive interruption against which repaired relation becomes newly visible.
Cutting a connection extends the interruption from body to a possible social-relational image.
Acquiring sought gain ties the sanction to enacted agency rather than an inherited status.
A penalty that restrains observers supplies the public deterrent function distinct from personal repair.

changed_reading.after: The focus adds a distinct post-sanction horizon: harmful agency is interrupted, yet a repairing person need not remain relationally identical to the offense.
changed_reading.before: 5:39 simply softens or reverses the preceding sanction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ruling joins severance, acquired gain, and exemplary restraint; the focus then joins return to reconciliation. The sequence carries two nonidentical responses to wrongdoing: interruption of harmful agency and a possible repaired re-entry under divine regard.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate severance/deterrence followed by reconciliation/return; I infer a movement from interrupted harmful agency toward possible reintegration. The focus explicitly guarantees divine response, while social or legal reinstatement remains a live but unconfirmed extension.
structural_cues: 5:38 and 5:39 are directly joined as sanction followed by return, repair, and divine response.
The focus changes grammatical attention from the punished hands and acquired act to whoever becomes a repairing subject.

activation_trace.role: Improper placement anchors the contextual word-displacement as a concrete species of wrong.
Restored fitness supplies the focus-side correction of displaced speech and judgment.
Deviation from direction makes distortion a directional displacement rather than only a false proposition.
The intelligible verbal unit identifies what is moved out of alignment.
A thing's settled position supplies the proper arrangement from which the words are shifted.
Restraint and return for correction make judgment an active repair mechanism.
Equity specifies the measure by which restored judgment is tested.

changed_reading.after: Repair can be epistemic and institutional: put words, evidence, judgments, and affected rights back into a fair relation.
changed_reading.before: أَصْلَحَ asks for generic moral improvement after a private offense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene concretizes focus-ظلم as displacement: intelligible words are bent away after their settled positions, then judgment is repeatedly ordered as restraining correction and equity. Focus-إصلاح can therefore require restoring testimony, wording, rulings, and rights to their proper configuration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displaced words, corrective judgment, and equity; I infer that these instantiate the focus's misplacement-to-fitness mechanism. The immediate addressees are interpreters and judges, so institutional repair is an activated application rather than the sole scope of 5:39.
structural_cues: 5:41 says words are altered after their positions; 5:42 answers with repeated commands to judge in equity.
The judgment block repeatedly contrasts entrusted wording and fair ruling with distortion, appetite, and turning away.

activation_trace.role: Responsive return anchors a turn toward restored relation rather than directionless reversal.
Stability and continuity make sustained reform the test of the turn's direction.
Turning one's back after judgment supplies a formally similar motion with the opposite relational direction.
Reversal away from committed religion supplies a second counter-return that cannot count as reparative turning.

changed_reading.after: Repentance is a sustained turn in the direction of repaired relation, shown by no longer turning away when judgment or allegiance becomes costly.
changed_reading.before: Any declared reversal after wrongdoing can count as repentance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies counter-turns: turning away after seeking judgment and reversing away from one's committed way. Against them, the doubled ت و ب becomes directionally specific and إصلاح becomes its persistence test; not every reversal is repentance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed directional verbs and the focus's repeated return plus repair; I infer that continuity of corrected alignment distinguishes repentance from tactical reversal. The counter-turns concern different groups, so the relation is structural rather than a claim of identical actors.
structural_cues: 5:43 places turning away after judgment in the later legal pericope.
5:54 names reversal from commitment before describing a differently aligned community.

remaining_uncertainties: 5:38-39 clearly adds divine reception after sanction, but social or legal reintegration is not explicit.
The 5:31 covering scene may signify dignified burial rather than evasive concealment, so its contrast with غفر must remain qualified.
The ت ب ب ruin/stability and ر ح م womb activations are diagnostically fertile but too form-distant or image-heavy to state as primary meanings.
strongest_changes: أَصْلَحَ became claimant-facing and life-preserving repair rather than an ornament added to regret.
The paired 5:34 'before power' and 5:39 'after wrongdoing' frames separated human enforcement timing from divine responsive forgiveness.
The displacement and fair-judgment sequence in 5:41-42 made repair epistemic and institutional as well as personal.
The surrounding counter-turns made repentance a sustained direction proved by repair, not any tactical reversal.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly supplied near-matches that failed one element of the focus: regret without repair, concealment without purification, ransom without changed agency, and turning without stable direction. Those contrasts made the compact تَابَ ... وَأَصْلَحَ ... يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِ sequence unusually functional.

activation_trace.role: Afterwardness leaves a temporal wake in which consequences and repair can coexist.
Corrective action changes the agent's trajectory without requiring a fiction that no damage occurred.
Aimed impact supplies the image of a consequence reaching its object.
The tail or rear of a thing images an offense's trailing aftermath.

changed_reading.after: The person can be received after genuine repair even while the wrong's trailing consequences remain matters to face and mend.
changed_reading.before: Divine forgiveness rewinds the event and removes every historical aftereffect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The tail image is a branch activation from ذ ن ب and should not be presented as the lexical meaning of every occurrence of 'sins.' It remains anchored because the focus explicitly stands after wrongdoing and requires corrective movement, while 5:49 combines sins with a targeted strike. Downstream prose should say the sequence 'evokes a trailing consequence,' not that forgiveness leaves a fixed penalty.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِنۢ بَعْدِ ظُلْمِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ locates repair after an act whose effects may continue behind the agent.

activation_trace.role: Ruin and loss expose the failure-pole from which reparative return departs.
An affair becoming prepared, upright, continuous, and clear supplies the durable-pole of repentance.
Repair provides the mechanism that carries the person from collapse toward stability.
Falling and collapse make failed action materially vivid.
General loss confirms the contextual ruin-pole against which stable reform resonates.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repentance pivots from a collapsing course into an affair made stable and continuous by repair.
changed_reading.before: Repentance is a momentary pivot away from a bad act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant ت ب ب mapping for focus ت و ب, so it is form-distant and must remain resonance rather than etymological identification. It is still worth carrying because the mapped branches explicitly oppose ruin to stabilization and 5:53 supplies collapsed works and loss. Render only as a consonantal branch echo that highlights why إصلاح must make return durable.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ت و ب is mapped not only to elicited repentance but also to a branch field spanning ruin and the settling of an affair.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover supplies the sheltering boundary of the analogy.
The womb as a house of growth makes mercy's protection generative rather than static.
Repair is the changed condition whose new growth the shelter supports.
Growth and increase supply the forward developmental motion of restored life.
Purity and soundness keep that growth morally tied to إصلاح.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy is a protected environment in which repaired agency can become sound and grow.
changed_reading.before: Mercy is a terminal acquittal after the offender repairs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The womb image is a branch of ر ح م and not a literal description of divine action. It remains anchored in the focus's رَّحِيمٌ beside protective غفر-covering, and 5:55 adds growth and purification. Downstream prose should qualify this as a generative spatial analogy: mercy can shelter repaired growth rather than merely close a case.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ closes the focus after return and repair, joining protective cover to a root branch of generative enclosure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Return is verified by restored soundness.** `ص ل ح B001` is soundness against corruption and `غ ف ر B002` shielding from consequence. Repentance is followed by repair, then divine turning. I infer that the inward reversal becomes legible through correction of the damaged social condition; mercy does not erase the repair step.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Return becomes effective through repair.** Fixed **ص ل ح / B001** (“soundness and rightness against corruption”) makes *aṣlaḥa* the concrete partner of repentance. The preceding 5:38 severed the organ of illicit acquisition; 5:41–5:44 soon describe corrupted hearing, displaced words, and judgment. I infer that inward reversal must restore sound relations damaged by the injustice rather than remain a private change of state. The ayah reads repentance as reparative re-entry into right order.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:44’s entrusted preservation of revealed judgment expanded “repair” from private remorse into restored fidelity to a public norm.

words.gloss_range: upon him; recipient/beneficiary complement of divine turning
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}) closes the apodosis on the recipient. The suffix points back to {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}), so the one who repented and repaired is exactly the one upon whom Allah turns. With {{ar:يَتُوبُ}} ({{tr:yatūbu}}), the preposition is benefactive, not hostile or merely locative; the spatial “upon” pressure remains, but local valency makes it mercy-directed, contrasting with power-over language in 5:34. The final suffix also echoes the suffix in {{ar:ظُلْمِهِ}} ({{tr:ẓulmihī}}), linking owned wrong to received divine turning.

words.gloss_range: second emphatic assertion particle opening the attribute coda
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) restarts the sentence with an independent attribute assertion. The first emphatic clause stated what Allah does; this second one grounds that action in what Allah is. Its renewed emphasis prevents {{ar:غَفُورٌ}} ({{tr:ghafūrun}}) and {{ar:رَّحِيمٌ}} ({{tr:raḥīmun}}) from sounding decorative: they explain why the response in {{ar:يَتُوبُ}} ({{tr:yatūbu}}) is reliable. The repeated emphatic sound also makes consequence and grounding answer one another.

words.gloss_range: Allah repeated as subject of the attribute coda
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) repeats the proper name instead of using a pronoun, giving the coda independent weight. The first {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) named the agent who turns; this second divine name bears the predicates {{ar:غَفُورٌ}} ({{tr:ghafūrun}}) and {{ar:رَّحِيمٌ}} ({{tr:raḥīmun}}). That repetition keeps action and nature parallel: the same Allah who turns upon the repentant is asserted as forgiving and merciful. The formula recurs in mercy seals such as 5:3, 5:34, 5:74, 5:98, and 2:182, so the coda is recognizable rather than incidental.

words.gloss_range: forgiving, covering-forgiving; first intensive predicate in the final attribute pair
words.prose: {{ar:غَفُورٌ}} ({{tr:ghafūrun}}) is the first predicate of the final coda, so covering-forgiveness is stated as what Allah is. The root {{ar:غ ف ر}} ({{tr:gh-f-r}}) carries covering and concealment, and the familiar protective-cover image gives forgiveness more than a bare cancellation sense; after {{ar:ظُلْمِهِ}} ({{tr:ẓulmihī}}), the wrong is covered rather than left exposed. The intensive pattern makes this an enduring quality, and its pairing with {{ar:رَّحِيمٌ}} ({{tr:raḥīmun}}) forms a recognized mercy formula in Surah 5 seals such as 5:3, 5:34, 5:74, and 5:98. The next ayah’s forgiveness language (5:40) carries this attribute forward into divine action.

words.gloss_range: merciful, mercy-giving; second intensive predicate completing the final attribute seal
words.prose: {{ar:رَّحِيمٌ}} ({{tr:raḥīmun}}) completes the ayah as the second predicate of the final coda. Its root {{ar:ر ح م}} ({{tr:r-ḥ-m}}) brings mercy, nurture, and womb-related compassion into the close, so the movement does not stop at covering the wrong but reaches restoration of the person. The intensive pattern makes mercy an abiding quality, and the word’s final position matters: after law, wrongdoing, repentance, repair, and divine turning, the ayah lands on mercy. Its pairing with {{ar:غَفُورٌ}} ({{tr:ghafūrun}}) is both formulaic and acoustically balanced, with the final cadence carrying the covering-then-nurturing sequence.
